macros.name: Topic
macros.doc: This is the main macro of the package; you can use it to wrap the optional ⟨content⟩ of a cell in order to allow it to merge with adjacent cells.

macros.name: TopicLine
macros.doc: \TopicLine can be used at the start of a row to automatically draw the horizontal lines that separates it from the row above and correctly accounts for merged cells.

macros.name: TopicSetVPos
macros.doc: You can set the vertical position for \Topic cells by using \TopicSetVPos.

macros.name: TopicSetWidth
macros.doc: You can set the width of the \Topic cells by using \TopicSetWidth.
